name: Silatar
summary: Silatar is an island estate in the Summerset archipelago. This is the island where Aranias grew up, and is visited only in the quest The Witch of Silatar, in a story told by Spinner Maruin at the Spinner's Cottage. Squirrels are found there. Hazards include: Slaughterfish
notes: You cannot use your mount in this zone.
